traceability.notes:
All functional aspects of story 002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG appear to be fully implemented and verified: - The plugin exposes recommended and strict presets as ESLint v9 flat-config arrays that only define rule severities, designed to be spread after a config object that registers the plugin (REQ-CONFIG-PRESETS, REQ-FLAT-CONFIG). Integration tests using FlatESLint confirm these presets enable the traceability rules when combined with an existing base config. - Rule meta.schema definitions for at least two core rules (valid-story-reference and require-story-annotation) provide explicit, restrictive JSON Schemas that validate configuration options and disallow unknown properties. Dedicated tests confirm these schemas are present and correct (REQ-RULE-OPTIONS, REQ-CONFIG-VALIDATION). This gives ESLint enough information to surface invalid options with clear error messages, satisfying the Error Handling acceptance criterion for configuration. - Customization of story file locations and patterns is supported via valid-story-reference rule options (storyDirectories, allowAbsolutePaths, requireStoryExtension) and thoroughly tested, fulfilling the intent of REQ-CUSTOMIZABLE-PATHS. - Extensive user documentation (README and user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md) provides clear setup instructions, multiple project-type examples (JS, TS, mixed, monorepo), and a troubleshooting section for ESLint configuration, meeting the UX and documentation acceptance criteria and demonstrating adherence to ESLint v9 flat-config best practices.
Given the concrete implementation, targeted tests mapped to this story, and comprehensive documentation, all specified acceptance criteria and technical requirements for this story are satisfied. Therefore this story is assessed as PASSED.
